verdict.rationale: Gecko's documented capability is AI-driven source-code (SAST) analysis across languages like TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, etc., producing call-chain/PoC findings and PR fixes — no evidence describes scanning container images for OS-package (e.g., CVE feeds on apt/rpm packages) or layered image vulnerabilities. The only container-adjacent mention is a changelog entry resolving a version to a digest-pinned image_ref, which is about release artifact resolution, not vulnerability scanning of container layers.
